serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Did you see the world outside?
You: Homelessness, poverty. It’s rampant in this city, everywhere!
You: People are tired of it and in anger they turn against each other. 
You: These last riots are the best example of it.
You: I’m hoping that your AI could fix it. Am I wrong?
Admin: Of course not! These problems are not alien to me. Even some of my friends suffer from them.
Admin: I want my AI to create a better world for everyone. World that would be as free from suffering as possible.
You: That’s exactly what I wanted to hear…
